tool.help:
**parabricks_minimap2**
NVIDIA Clara Parabricks GPU-accelerated minimap2 for aligning long read sequences against a large reference database using an accelerated KSW2 to convert FASTQ to BAM/CRAM.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: parabricks/minimap2 - Container: biocontainers/parabricks/minimap2:latest
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
